diagnoses.display: Unspecified infection due to central venous catheter, initial encounter
Anemia in other chronic diseases classified elsewhere
Acute and subacute hepatic failure without coma
Presence of coronary angioplasty implant and graft
Urinary tract infection, site not specified
Atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary artery with other forms of angina pectoris
Hypertensive chronic kidney disease with stage 1 through stage 4 chronic kidney disease, or unspecified chronic kidney disease
Other specified bacterial agents as the cause of diseases classified elsewhere
Methicillin susceptible Staphylococcus aureus infection as the cause of diseases classified elsewhere
Sepsis due to Escherichia coli [E. coli]
Acute and subacute hepatic failure with coma
Other medical procedures as the cause of abnormal reaction of the patient, or of later complication, without mention of misadventure at the time of the procedure
Postprocedural hemorrhage of a circulatory system organ or structure following a cardiac catheterization
Acute respiratory failure, unspecified whether with hypoxia or hypercapnia
